text: Code reviews are an important part of software development. When developers review each other's code before it is added to a project, they can catch bugs early, which saves time and money later. Code reviews also support knowledge sharing, because team members learn from each other and understand different parts of the codebase. In addition, regular reviews help maintain team quality by keeping the code clean, consistent, and easy to read. Although code reviews take some time, they are a valuable investment for any development team that wants to build reliable software.
